Location-Based AR Immersive Solutions

Our AR solutions leverage geolocation to create interactive, real-world experiences that enhance engagement, boost visibility, and transform how users interact with your brand.

What is Location-Based AR?
Location-based AR uses real-world locations to trigger digital experiences, seamlessly blending physical and virtual environments for immersive interactions.
Benefits for E-commerce & Retail
Deliver AR promotions, virtual product demos, and in-store experiences that increase engagement and drive conversions.
Enhancing Customer Engagement

Geo-Targeted Marketing

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Augmented Reality (AR) marketing? +

AR marketing blends digital elements with the physical world using smartphones or AR devices, allowing customers to interact with products and experiences in immersive ways.

How does EON8 use AR for marketing? +

EON8 creates immersive AR campaigns including product demos, interactive ads, and location-based experiences tailored to your brand.

What industries benefit from AR marketing? +

Industries like retail, real estate, education, tourism, and entertainment benefit greatly from AR by enhancing engagement.

How can AR increase e-commerce sales? +

AR helps customers visualize products before purchase, increasing confidence and reducing returns, leading to higher conversions.

What makes EON8 different from other AR agencies? +

EON8 offers end-to-end AR solutions with customized strategies, continuous support, and performance optimization.
